challenge.title: A visit to the masjid
challenge.instructions: Write a short conversation in Fusha in which you ask about the next prayer and the iqamah, find the entrance, make wudu, put your shoes on the rack, find the qibla, silence your phone, and say what you do when you are late.
required_elements: a question about the next prayer or the time of the adhan or iqamah
a question about the entrance or the wudu area
a request for the shoe rack, a prayer rug or the qibla
a polite request or reply about the phone with مِنْ فَضْلِك or شُكْرًا
a missed rak'ah explained with فَاتَتْنِي and a closing تَقَبَّلَ اللهُ

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ. مَا الصَّلَاةُ الْقَادِمَة؟
dialogue.transliteration: as-salaamu 3alaykum. maa aS-Salaatu al-qaadima?
dialogue.english: Peace be upon you. Which prayer is next?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَام. صَلَاةُ الْمَغْرِب، وَالْإِقَامَةُ بَعْدَ عَشْرِ دَقَائِق.
dialogue.transliteration: wa 3alaykumu as-salaam. Salaatu al-maghrib, wa al-iqaamatu ba3da 3ashri daqaa2iq.
dialogue.english: And peace be upon you. The Maghrib prayer, and the iqamah is in ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَتَوَضَّأ. أَيْنَ مَكَانُ الْوُضُوء؟
dialogue.transliteration: ureedu an atawaDDa2. ayna makaanu al-wuDoo2?
dialogue.english: I want to make wudu. Where is the wudu area?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: بِجَانِبِ دَوْرَةِ الْمِيَاه. وَضَعْ حِذَاءَكَ عَلَى الرَّفّ عِنْدَ الْمَدْخَل.
dialogue.transliteration: bijaanibi dawrati al-miyaah. wa Da3 Hidhaa2aka 3alaa ar-raff 3inda al-madkhal.
dialogue.english: Next to the restrooms. And put your shoes on the rack at the entrance.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: شُكْرًا. فِي أَيِّ اتِّجَاهٍ الْقِبْلَة؟
dialogue.transliteration: shukran. fii ayyi ittijaahin al-qibla?
dialogue.english: Thanks. Which way is the qibla?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: الْقِبْلَةُ إِلَى الْيَمِين. وَمِنْ فَضْلِك، اِجْعَلْ هَاتِفَكَ عَلَى الصَّامِت.
dialogue.transliteration: al-qiblatu ilaa al-yameen. wa min faDlik, ij3al haatifaka 3alaa aS-Saamit.
dialogue.english: The qibla is to the right. And please put your phone on silent.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: حَاضِر. أَيْنَ مَدْخَلُ الرِّجَال؟
dialogue.transliteration: HaaDir. ayna madkhalu ar-rijaal?
dialogue.english: Right away. Where is the men's entrance?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: مِنَ الْبَابِ الرَّئِيسِيّ. أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاة، هَيَّا بِنَا.
dialogue.transliteration: mina al-baabi ar-ra2eesiyy. uqeemati aS-Salaa, hayyaa binaa.
dialogue.english: Through the main door. The iqamah has been called, come on.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: فَاتَتْنِي رَكْعَةٌ لِأَنَّنِي دَخَلْتُ مُتَأَخِّرًا.
dialogue.transliteration: faatatnee rak3atun li-annanee dakhaltu muta2akhkhiran.
dialogue.english: I missed a rak'ah because I came in late.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ، أَتِمَّ مَا فَاتَكَ. تَقَبَّلَ اللهُ.
dialogue.transliteration: laa ba2sa, atimma maa faataka. taqabbala Allaah.
dialogue.english: No problem, complete what you missed. May Allah accept it from you.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: مِنَّا وَمِنْكُمْ. جَزَاكَ اللهُ خَيْرًا.
dialogue.transliteration: minnaa wa minkum. jazaaka Allaahu khayran.
dialogue.english: From us and from you. May Allah reward you with good.

reply.english: At the end of the street.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ. أَيْنَ الْمَسْجِدُ الْقَرِيب؟
dialogue.transliteration: as-salaamu 3alaykum. ayna al-masjidu al-qareeb?
dialogue.english: Peace be upon you. Where is the nearest masjid?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ. عِنْدَ آخِرِ الشَّارِع.
dialogue.transliteration: wa 3alaykumu as-salaamu wa raHmatu Allaah. 3inda aakhiri ash-shaari3.
dialogue.english: And peace and the mercy of Allah be upon you. At the end of the street.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: بَعْدَ عَشْرِ دَقَائِق، وَالْإِقَامَةُ بَعْدَهُ بِخَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ دَقِيقَة.
dialogue.transliteration: ba3da 3ashri daqaa2iq, wa al-iqaamatu ba3dahu bikhamsa 3ashrata daqeeqa.
dialogue.english: In ten minutes, and the iqamah is fifteen minutes after it.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: هَيَّا نُصَلِّي جَمَاعَةً. أَيْنَ مَدْخَلُ الرِّجَال؟
dialogue.transliteration: hayyaa nuSallee jamaa3atan. ayna madkhalu ar-rijaal?
dialogue.english: Let's pray in congregation. Where is the men's entrance?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: مِنَ الْبَابِ الرَّئِيسِيّ. وَمَدْخَلُ النِّسَاءِ مِنَ الْبَابِ الْجَانِبِيّ.
dialogue.transliteration: mina al-baabi ar-ra2eesiyy. wa madkhalu an-nisaa2i mina al-baabi al-jaanibiyy.
dialogue.english: Through the main door. The women's entrance is through the side door.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاة. هَيَّا بِنَا.
dialogue.transliteration: uqeemati aS-Salaa. hayyaa binaa.
dialogue.english: The iqamah has been called. Come on.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ: فَاتَتْنِي رَكْعَةٌ لِأَنَّنِي دَخَلْتُ مُتَأَخِّرًا.
dialogue.transliteration: ba3da aS-Salaati: faatatnee rak3atun li-annanee dakhaltu muta2akhkhiran.
dialogue.english: After the prayer: I missed a rak'ah because I came in late.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ، أَتِمَّ مَا فَاتَكَ. تَقَبَّلَ اللهُ.
dialogue.transliteration: laa ba2sa, atimma maa faataka. taqabbala Allaah.
dialogue.english: No problem, complete what you missed. May Allah accept it from you.

pair.english: I am late, can I join?

lessons.culture: The adhan calls people to each of the five daily prayers, and the iqamah, said just before the prayer starts, tells everyone to stand in rows. Many masjids have separate entrances and prayer areas for men and women. Someone who joins late prays with the imam, then stands and completes the missed rak'ahs after the imam's salaam.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'When is the adhan?'
exercises.tip: mataa asks when; al-adhaan is the call to prayer.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'I missed a rak'ah'
exercises.tip: faata is to pass by; the rak'ah passed me by.

exercises.prompt: Which one means 'The iqamah has been called, the prayer is starting'?
exercises.tip: Said when the imam is about to begin; the verb is passive.

exercises.prompt: Which one means 'Where is the women's entrance?'
exercises.tip: madkhal is an entrance; an-nisaa2 are the women.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'Let's pray in congregation'
exercises.tip: hayyaa means come on; jamaa3atan means in a group.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'I will complete what I missed after the salaam'

too_formal.item: رح كمل يلي فاتني بعد السلام

exercises.tip: sa- makes the verb future; at-tasleem is the final salaam of the prayer.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence: 'أَيْنَ مَدْخَلُ _____؟' (Where is the men's entrance?)
exercises.tip: rijaal are men; the noun after madkhal takes a kasra.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence: 'فَاتَتْنِي _____' (I missed a rak'ah)
exercises.tip: A rak'ah is one full cycle of standing, bowing and prostrating.

exercises.prompt: You hear: 'مَتَى الْإِقَامَة؟'. Say: fifteen minutes after the adhan.
exercises.tip: ba3da means after; the iqamah comes after the adhan.

exercises.prompt: You hear: 'تَقَبَّلَ اللهُ'. Answer with the usual reply.
exercises.tip: Said after prayer or worship; the full wish is taqabbala Allaahu minnaa wa minkum.

reply.english: There are rugs in the corner.
The qibla is to the right.

phrases.arabic: مِنْ فَضْلِك، اِجْعَلْ هَاتِفَكَ عَلَى الصَّامِت
نَسِيتُ أَنْ أَجْعَلَ هَاتِفِي عَلَى الصَّامِت

reply.english: There is a locker next to the door.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: أَيْنَ مَكَانُ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْ فَضْلِك؟
dialogue.transliteration: ayna makaanu al-wuDoo2i min faDlik?
dialogue.english: Where is the wudu area, please?

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.arabic: بِجَانِبِ دَوْرَةِ الْمِيَاه، عَلَى الْيَمِين.
dialogue.transliteration: bijaanibi dawrati al-miyaah, 3alaa al-yameen.
dialogue.english: Next to the restrooms, on the right.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، الْمَاءُ مُتَوَفِّر. وَيَجِبُ أَنْ تَكُونَ الثِّيَابُ نَظِيفَة.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, al-maa2u mutawaffir. wa yajibu an takoona ath-thiyaabu naDeefa.
dialogue.english: Yes, water is available. And clothes must be clean.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: وَأَيْنَ رَفُّ الْأَحْذِيَة؟
dialogue.transliteration: wa ayna raffu al-aHdhiya?
dialogue.english: And where is the shoe rack?

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.arabic: عِنْدَ الْمَدْخَل. ضَعْ حِذَاءَكَ عَلَى الرَّفّ.
dialogue.transliteration: 3inda al-madkhal. Da3 Hidhaa2aka 3alaa ar-raff.
dialogue.english: At the entrance. Put your shoes on the rack.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.arabic: الْقِبْلَةُ إِلَى الْيَمِين. وَمِنْ فَضْلِك، اِجْعَلْ هَاتِفَكَ عَلَى الصَّامِت.
dialogue.transliteration: al-qiblatu ilaa al-yameen. wa min faDlik, ij3al haatifaka 3alaa aS-Saamit.
dialogue.english: The qibla is to the right. And please put your phone on silent.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: حَاضِر، شُكْرًا لَك.
dialogue.transliteration: HaaDir, shukran lak.
dialogue.english: Right away, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللهُ خَيْرًا.
dialogue.transliteration: jazaaka Allaahu khayran.
dialogue.english: May Allah reward you with good.

response.english: The qibla is to the right.

lessons.culture: Wudu is the washing done before prayer, and masjids keep a wudu area, usually near the restrooms, with taps and seats. Shoes come off at the entrance, clothes should be clean and modest, and phones are put on silent so nobody's prayer is disturbed. The qibla is the direction of the Kaaba in Makkah, and a niche called the mihrab often marks it.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'I want to make wudu'
exercises.tip: atawaDDa2 is I make wudu; an makes the verb follow ureedu.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'Which way is the qibla?'
exercises.tip: ittijaah is a direction; fii ayyi means in which.

exercises.prompt: Which one means 'Where is the shoe rack?'
exercises.tip: raff is a rack; aHdhiya are shoes.

exercises.prompt: Which one means 'Please put your phone on silent'?
options: مِنْ فَضْلِك، اِجْعَلْ هَاتِفَكَ عَلَى الصَّامِت
نَسِيتُ أَنْ أَجْعَلَ هَاتِفِي عَلَى الصَّامِت
exercises.answer: مِنْ فَضْلِك، اِجْعَلْ هَاتِفَكَ عَلَى الصَّامِت
accepted: مِنْ فَضْلِك، اِجْعَلْ هَاتِفَكَ عَلَى الصَّامِت
من فضلك، اجعل هاتفك على الصامت
exercises.tip: ij3al is make; aS-Saamit is the silent setting.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'Put your shoes on the rack'
exercises.tip: Da3 is put, said to one man; to a woman: Da3ee.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'Where is the prayer rug?'
exercises.tip: ayna opens the question, then the noun.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence: 'هَلْ يُوجَدُ _____؟' (Is there water?)
exercises.tip: yoojadu means is found, so it asks if something exists.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence: 'الْقِبْلَةُ إِلَى _____' (The qibla is to the right)
exercises.tip: al-yameen is right; ash-shimaal is left.

exercises.prompt: You hear: 'هَلْ يُوجَدُ مَاءٌ؟'. Say: yes, water is available.
exercises.tip: mutawaffir means available.

exercises.prompt: You hear: 'مِنْ فَضْلِك، اِجْعَلْ هَاتِفَكَ عَلَى الصَّامِت'. Agree politely.
exercises.tip: HaaDir means ready, at your service.

reply.english: Shaykh Khalid will give the khutbah and lead us.

reply.arabic: تَفَضَّلْ، هُنَا مَكَانٌ فِي الصَّفِّ الثَّانِي
reply.transliteration: tafaDDal, hunaa makaanun fee aS-Saffi ath-thaanee
reply.english: Please, there is a place here in the second row.
A blessed Friday to you too.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا يُوسُف. مَتَى صَلَاةُ الْجُمُعَة؟
dialogue.transliteration: as-salaamu 3alaykum yaa yoosuf. mataa Salaatu al-jumu3a?
dialogue.english: Peace be upon you, Yusuf. When is the Friday prayer?

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَام. فِي الثَّانِيَةَ عَشْرَةَ وَالنِّصْف.
dialogue.transliteration: wa 3alaykumu as-salaam. fee ath-thaaniyata 3ashrata wa an-niSf.
dialogue.english: And peace be upon you. At half past twelve.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: فِكْرَةٌ جَيِّدَة. اِغْتَسَلْتُ وَلَبِسْتُ ثِيَابًا نَظِيفَة.
dialogue.transliteration: fikratun jayyida. ightasaltu wa labistu thiyaaban naDheefa.
dialogue.english: A good idea. I have bathed and put on clean clothes.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: وَأَنَا كَذَلِكَ. مَنْ هُوَ الْإِمَامُ الْيَوْم؟
dialogue.transliteration: wa ana kadhaalik. man huwa al-imaamu al-yawm?
dialogue.english: Me too. Who is the imam today?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: الْمَسْجِدُ مُزْدَحِم. هَلْ يُوجَدُ مَكَانٌ فَارِغ؟
dialogue.transliteration: al-masjidu muzdaHim. hal yoojadu makaanun faarigh?
dialogue.english: The mosque is crowded. Is there an empty place?

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا. مِنْ فَضْلِكُمْ، تَقَارَبُوا قَلِيلًا.
dialogue.transliteration: jazaaka allaahu khayran. min faDlikum, taqaarabuu qaleelan.
dialogue.english: May Allah reward you with good. Please, move closer together a little.

dialogue.speaker: Brother
dialogue.arabic: وَإِيَّاكَ. سَتَبْدَأُ الْخُطْبَةُ بَعْدَ قَلِيل، أَنْصِتُوا.
dialogue.transliteration: wa iyyaak. sa-tabda2u al-khuTbatu ba3da qaleel, anSitoo.
dialogue.english: And you too. The khutbah will begin soon, listen quietly.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: تَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنَّا وَمِنْكُمْ. جُمُعَةٌ مُبَارَكَة.
dialogue.transliteration: taqabbala allaahu minnaa wa minkum. jumu3atun mubaaraka.
dialogue.english: May Allah accept from us and from you. Blessed Friday.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: آمِين، جُمُعَةٌ مُبَارَكَةٌ لَكَ أَيْضًا. سَأُصَلِّي السُّنَّةَ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَة.
dialogue.transliteration: aameen, jumu3atun mubaarakatun laka aydan. sa-uSalli as-sunnata ba3da al-jumu3a.
dialogue.english: Ameen, a blessed Friday to you too. I will pray the sunnah after Jumu'ah.

response.english: Shaykh Khalid will give the khutbah and lead us.

response.arabic: تَفَضَّلْ، هُنَا مَكَانٌ فِي الصَّفِّ الثَّانِي
response.transliteration: tafaDDal, hunaa makaanun fee aS-Saffi ath-thaanee
response.english: Please, there is a place here in the second row.
A blessed Friday to you too.

lessons.culture: Jumu'ah replaces the Dhuhr prayer on Friday and is prayed in congregation after a khutbah. Many people bathe (ghusl), wear clean clothes and perfume, and come early, and during the khutbah everyone listens in silence, since even telling a neighbour to be quiet is discouraged. In a crowded mosque the rows are filled by moving closer, and after the prayer people greet each other with جُمُعَةٌ مُبَارَكَة.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'Let us go early to Jumu'ah'
exercises.tip: mubakkireen means early, as a group.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'Listen quietly to the khutbah'
exercises.tip: anSitoo is said to a group: be silent and listen.

exercises.prompt: Which one means 'Is there an empty place?'
exercises.tip: faarigh is empty.

exercises.prompt: Which one means 'Please, move closer together a little'?
exercises.tip: Rows are filled by closing the gaps.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'Who is the imam today?'
exercises.tip: man asks about a person.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'I will pray the sunnah after the Friday prayer'
exercises.tip: sa- before a verb makes it future.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence: 'سَتَبْدَأُ _____ بَعْدَ قَلِيل' (The khutbah will begin soon)
exercises.tip: khuTba is the sermon.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence: 'اِغْتَسَلْتُ وَلَبِسْتُ _____ نَظِيفَة' (I bathed and put on clean clothes)
exercises.tip: thiyaab means clothes and takes a feminine adjective here.

exercises.prompt: You hear: 'جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا'. Reply.
exercises.tip: The standard answer is wa iyyaak, and you too.

exercises.prompt: You hear: 'جُمُعَةٌ مُبَارَكَة'. Reply.
exercises.tip: Return the same wish.

phrases.arabic: هَلْ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ سُؤَالًا يَا أُسْتَاذ؟
phrases.transliteration: hal astaTee3u an as2alaka su2aalan yaa ustaadh?

reply.arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللَّه، بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيك
reply.transliteration: maa shaa2a allaah, baaraka allaahu feek
reply.english: As Allah willed, may Allah bless you.

phrases.arabic: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَمِّعَ لَكَ مَا حَفِظْتُ
phrases.transliteration: ureedu an usammi3a laka maa Hafiztu

reply.english: On the notice board at the entrance.

phrases.arabic: أُرِيدُ تَسْجِيلَ ابْنِي فِي حَلْقَةِ الْأَطْفَال
phrases.transliteration: ureedu tasjeela ibnee fee Halqati al-aTfaal

reply.english: Yes, you will find it on the shelf.

phrases.arabic: سَأُعِيدُ الْمُصْحَفَ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّه
phrases.transliteration: sa-u3eedu al-muSHafa ghadan in shaa2a allaah

dialogue.speaker: Ahmad
dialogue.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أُسْتَاذ. مَتَى حَلْقَةُ الْقُرْآن؟
dialogue.transliteration: as-salaamu 3alaykum yaa ustaadh. mataa Halqatu al-qur2aan?
dialogue.english: Peace be upon you, teacher. When is the Qur'an class?

dialogue.speaker: Ustadh
dialogue.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَام. بَعْدَ صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِب.
dialogue.transliteration: wa 3alaykumu as-salaam. ba3da Salaati al-maghrib.
dialogue.english: And peace be upon you. After the Maghrib prayer.

dialogue.speaker: Ahmad
dialogue.arabic: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَنْضَمَّ إِلَى الْحَلْقَة. أَيْنَ جَدْوَلُ الدُّرُوس؟
dialogue.transliteration: ureedu an anDamma ilaa al-Halqa. ayna jadwalu ad-duroos?
dialogue.english: I want to join the circle. Where is the timetable of lessons?

dialogue.speaker: Ahmad
dialogue.arabic: أَحْفَظُ سُورَةَ الْمُلْك. أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَمِّعَ لَكَ مَا حَفِظْتُ.
dialogue.transliteration: aHfaDhu sooratal-mulk. ureedu an usammi3a laka maa Hafiztu.
dialogue.english: I am memorising Surat al-Mulk. I want to recite to you what I have memorised.

dialogue.speaker: Ustadh
dialogue.arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللَّه، بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيك. تَفَضَّلْ، اِبْدَأْ.
dialogue.transliteration: maa shaa2a allaah, baaraka allaahu feek. tafaDDal, ibda2.
dialogue.english: As Allah willed, may Allah bless you. Please, begin.

dialogue.speaker: Ahmad
dialogue.arabic: هَلْ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ سُؤَالًا؟ هَلْ تُعِيدُ الْآيَةَ مِنْ فَضْلِك؟
dialogue.transliteration: hal astaTee3u an as2alaka su2aalan? hal tu3eedu al-aaya min faDlik?
dialogue.english: May I ask you a question? Could you repeat the verse, please?

dialogue.speaker: Ustadh
dialogue.arabic: تَفَضَّلْ، اِسْأَلْ. نَعَمْ، سَأُعِيدُهَا.
dialogue.transliteration: tafaDDal, is2al. na3am, sa-u3eeduhaa.
dialogue.english: Please, ask. Yes, I will repeat it.

dialogue.speaker: Ahmad
dialogue.arabic: وَأُرِيدُ تَسْجِيلَ ابْنِي فِي حَلْقَةِ الْأَطْفَال.
dialogue.transliteration: wa ureedu tasjeela ibnee fee Halqati al-aTfaal.
dialogue.english: And I want to sign up my son for the children's circle.

dialogue.speaker: Ahmad
dialogue.arabic: عُمْرُهُ سَبْعُ سَنَوَات. وَهَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي اسْتِعَارَةُ مُصْحَف؟
dialogue.transliteration: 3umruhu sab3u sanawaat. wa hal yumkinunee isti3aaratu muSHaf?
dialogue.english: He is seven years old. And may I borrow a mushaf?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، مَكْتَبَةُ الْمَسْجِدِ فِي الطَّابِقِ الْأَوَّل، وَتَجِدُ الْمَصَاحِفَ عَلَى الرَّفّ.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, maktabatu al-masjidi fee aT-Taabiqi al-awwal, wa tajidu al-maSaaHifa 3alaa ar-raff.
dialogue.english: Yes, the mosque library is on the first floor, and you will find the mushafs on the shelf.

pair.english: Where is the timetable of lessons?

response.english: On the notice board at the entrance.

lessons.culture: Many mosques run Qur'an circles (Halaqaat) for adults and children, often after Maghrib or Fajr, where each student recites from memory to the teacher, who is addressed as أُسْتَاذ or شَيْخ. The mushaf is handled with respect: held with clean hands, kept off the floor, and returned to its shelf after use.

exercises.tip: aHfaDhu is I memorise.

ureedu tasjeela ibnee fee Halqati al-aTfaal
exercises.tip: tasjeel is registering; Halqa is a study circle.

exercises.answer: مَا شَاءَ اللَّه، بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيك
accepted: مَا شَاءَ اللَّه، بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيك
ما شاء الله، بارك الله فيك
